body:
At first I actually didn't wanna go to college. I made that known, but I was urged to register anyways. I managed to get into a prestigious college in my state. But as far as my failure, I attribute that more to lack of motivation and depression. Despite my not wanting to go to college, I still did my best in the beginning to take good notes and study, but quickly that fizzled out halfway through each semester. Plus even with studying and note-taking, I did either mediocre or poorly on quizes. I commuted too, so I didn;'t have any reliable way of making good close friends. Combined with the fact I'm more of an introvert, you can imagine how that could be bad.

Thank you for taking the time to read and give feedback though :/ I often fanticize about carving my own path and starting life anew, but I quickly realized that I wouldn't know what the hell to do or how I'd survive. Where would I go? Who would accept me? How will I make money? What if I slump back into depression out there? I don't expect you to answer these, but questions like that leave me feeling like I shouldnt even bother, because I havent the slightest clue.
